Likely files: src/database/mongo/hash.js, src/database/redis/hash.js, src/database/postgres/hash.js. All getObject/getObjects signatures omit fields. Existing Postgres getObject/getObjects query full data directly and preserve order via WITH ORDINALITY.

Fix behavior to cover: optional fields argument and callback compatibility, full object for [] or omitted fields through all four methods, selected fields only with null for absent field names, null/falsy missing-key result for public getObject/getObjects, input order and duplicates, all three backends. Existing tests in test/database/hash.js cover selected helper fields and missing fields but not [] or selected public methods.
